summary: Positive Phase 2 hot-flash data for ABCL635 on 2026-08-10 (up as much as 41%) drove the 60-day rally. On 9/16 it set an IMS presentation for 10/1, and the stock ran up into it. JPMorgan began at Overweight ($17) on 9/29.
support_reason: Phase 2 efficacy is real, but this is a clinical-stage biotech; the late-September run-up was speculative and faded after the 10/1 presentation.
dilution_or_offering: $200M offering at $9.75/share priced 2026-08-12 (424B5); 60-day lock-up ends about mid-October
short_interest_or_squeeze: 33.9M shares short as of 9/15, about 11% of shares outstanding, 9.6 days to cover
